text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainerrr~ About that "healing training"
we were talking about the other day—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: The weather's so nice, how about we go after this?
choice_data_list: ...! Yes, please!

text_block_list.text: "It seems Hishi Miracle remembered what came to light last time—that I'm 'bad at relaxing.'"
Since they're going out of their way to teach me... I want to master it properly today and put it to good use in the future!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that the picnic mat is spread out,
let's just lounge around here for a while~.

At the top of the hill Hishi Miracle led me to,
I promptly laid out a picnic mat
and looked up at the sky.
choice_data_list: (It's a great day for training...)

text_block_list.text:
—No, wait!
I came here to relax today.
I must forget about training and rest.

choice_data_list: ...Music? Where on earth is it coming from—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Actually, the festival venue is just a short distance away from here~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Like background music floating in just right from a distance.
It's actually really nice, you know~.
choice_data_list: This vibe really is so soothing~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice catch~.
Those doggies run so fast~.
choice_data_list: So this park even has a dog run, huh.
So this park has a dog run too.

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, stop that! Goodness, I'm so sorry.
It seems this little one just wants to play with you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no worries~
Since you're here, wanna hang out to help digest our food?

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait! I'm throwing the ball now!
D-Don't chase after me~!
choice_data_list: That acceleration when she's cornered... I love it!
That acceleration when she's cornered... nice!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*~ That was so refreshing.
A 'footbath cafe' after a workout is the absolute best~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...How was it for you, Trainer?
Our final relaxation spot, the footbath cafe~
choice_data_list: I think I'll spend my rest days here from now on!

text_block_list.text:
It relieves fatigue in your legs, and the fancy food
lifts your spirits! Truly a place that kills two birds with one stone!

—Fufu, as expected of
Mirako-chan's "Relaxation Tour"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "What a coincidence! We're in the middle of a 'Healing Tour,' personally recommended by Mirako-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: By the way, what is today's "theme"?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, today's theme is...
"Even the hardest workers will end up slacking off!
The ultimate irresistible relaxation spots!" I guess~
choice_data_list: Bewitching healing? ...Ah!

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I was in the middle of 'relaxation training'!
I completely forgot halfway through
and started thinking about work.
choice_data_list: (Huh? But—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see! Mirako-chan's Trainer really is such a hard worker, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~ I think I hit the right spots pretty well.
How are you feeling, Trainer? Any fatigue?
choice_data_list: Well, there wasn't any at all...

text_block_list.text:
Listening to the music
while thinking about work...

Finding hints for training
even while playing with the dogs.
choice_data_list: Even after working, they're not tired at all...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My theme, 'Rest the legs, not the hands,' was optimal
for balancing work and recuperation.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I've been able to keep running this far without breaking my stride in races.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Barefoot is best for both legs and soul!" was also
just what I needed since I tend to overwork myself!
choice_data_list: I didn't know there were so many ways to relax and unwind...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you know~?
Different things work for different people!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you feel refreshed,
then maybe today's vibe suits you well, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, when it comes to seeing through that sort of thing,
I'm just a tiiiiny bit more confident than average."
choice_data_list: You're an amazingly capable Trainer!
You're an amazingly capable Trainer!
You really thought this through for me, didn't you?
You put a lot of thought into this for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, when it comes to seeing through that sort of thing,
I'm just a tiiiiny bit more confident than average."
choice_data_list: You're an amazingly capable Trainer!
You're an amazingly capable Trainer!
You really thought this through for me, didn't you?
You put a lot of thought into this for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Ikuno
text_block_list.text: A capable Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ ummm..., the whole Trainer thing
is just something Trainer-san says on their own~.
choice_data_list: You're my "healing" Trainer, after all.
You're my "healing" Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Sounds great! I also think they're a super-duper capable Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
J-Jeez!
Flattery will get you nowhere, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I say that, but I'm really just
going with the flow, you know~
choice_data_list: I want to get into the footbath one more time.

text_block_list.text:
I want to savor this soothing comfort
she worked so hard to come up with just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sounds nice~.
Since you're here, why don't you two join in too?
(Plop...♪)
choice_data_list: Aaah, this is bliss~~~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Such bliss~~~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
I can't help but admire a relationship like that!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...It might also have the effect of soothing those of us watching.
